titleEn: But You Said It Wouldn't Rain!

pages.text: Grandma spread the rice out across the yard. The sun was shining brightly.
Dingding saw a long line of ants on the bank. They were crowding into their nest.
"If it rains, all the rice will get wet!" Dingding said. Grandma looked up at the sky.
"Clouds like these don't bring rain," Grandma said. The clouds were white and round.
The line of ants grew longer. "They're all going home. It must be going to rain!" Dingding kept looking up at the sky.
The clouds grew thicker. The wind felt cool.
Grandma sat in the shade, fanning herself. "The rain is still a long way off. Come sit down."
Dingding swept the rice into a bamboo basket. Then Dingding gathered half of Grandma's rice, too.
Pitter-patter! Suddenly, rain came pouring down.
Under the roof, Dingding hugged the basket. Grandma ran over with her fan above her head. The ants were already safely inside their nest.
